name: Malak Hifni Nasif
shortBio: Egyptian feminist philosopher and social critic (pen name Bahithat al-Badiya) who articulated an indigenous Islamic reformist feminism opposing both patriarchal conservatism and uncritical mimicry of European colonialism.
centralQuestion: How can Arab women achieve legal, educational, and marital justice within indigenous ethical traditions without becoming instruments of colonial cultural domination?

keyWorks.title: Al-Nisa'iyyat (Women's Pieces)
keyWorks.description: Collected lectures and essays presenting a ten-point feminist program for girls’ education, mosque access, and marriage law reform.
